newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Rand returns confidence to S.African industrials.
newsitem.headline: Rand returns confidence to S.African industrials.

text.p: A stronger rand and bond market during the afternoon pushed South African industrial shares into firmer territory after a weak start.
Traders said investment funds returned to the market by late morning, continuing a trend started on Wednesday, buying cheap stocks.
The industrial index ended up 18.7 points at 8,020.1 and were expected firm again on Friday, although eyeing Wall Street overnight.
Gold stocks fell for the sixth consecutive session but ended off the day's weakest levels on perceptions that the $354-an-ounce level on bullion offered strong resistance.
The all gold index finished 8.6 points down at 1390.1 but dealers said some good buying had been evident at the lower levels.
The all share index was down 3.3 points at 6,647.9.
